classes.name: CatalogItemGetByIdEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint class that handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve catalog item details by ID, interacts with the repository, maps data to a DTO, and returns appropriate HTTP results.

methods.name: CatalogItemGetByIdEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a URI composer dependency.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the route for handling GET requests to 'api/catalog-items/{catalogItemId}', associating it with the HandleAsync method.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the incoming request, retrieves the catalog item by the provided ID from the repository, checks for null, maps it to a response DTO, and returns HTTP 200 or 404.
